skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts related to operations and operational management.
Understand strategic concepts and theories related to operations.
Apply decision-making techniques to practical operational problems.
Combine experience, knowledge, and tools to solve operational management issues.
Understand the essence and role of comprehensive planning.
Understand resource planning techniques such as MRP and ERP.
Understand the essence and role of production scheduling.
Understand the concept and application of Just-In-Time manufacturing.
Understand the concept and methods of lean production.
Understand the essence and role of maintenance management.
Understand the essence and role of operational strategy.
Analyze scenarios presented in the textbook.
Analyze real-world examples in operations management.
